title: 第六章 峰回路转春秋丹
slug: 傲世九重天全本免费-傲世九重天最新章节列表
content_zh:
心境动摇之下，现在孟超然就算是执意想走，也走不成了。
“暂时出不去了。我需要闭关一下。”孟超然目光一凝，打量了楚阳一会，见楚阳神色如常，似乎刚才那句话只是无心之言，才无奈的笑了起来。
刚刚说了要出去，但接着却又说出不去了。这等朝令夕改的事情，本来最容易为人所不齿，但孟超然却似乎没有任何顾忌，就这么平淡地说了出来。似乎这种事，很是平常。
“恩，对了。这颗春秋丹，楚阳服用了吧。”孟超然微笑着一扬手，扔过来一个小玉瓶，道：“刚才千山也说过，楚阳的伤需要补一补。就用这个补一补吧。”他的微笑之中，似乎稍稍带着一丝讥诮之意，很是有些意味深长……
石千山顿时脸色大变！
春秋丹是用来提升功力的，怎么能用来补血补身体？宗门那么多疗伤的药，何必要用春秋丹？
自己那句话，只是为了让师傅对这两个师弟产生一下恶感罢了，怎地却弄巧成拙，一下子把春秋丹弄没了？
这……这话是咋说的？
楚阳敏感地看到孟超然嘴角一闪即逝的讥诮之意，不由得心头苦笑：看来这石千山的阴谋诡计，都在自己师傅的眼中啊……只是，他为何从来都不阻止？
还有这次赐予自己春秋丹，绝对是为了自己那一句“天地不移、江流石不转”。但自己这位师傅倒真的沉得住气，居然什么也没问……
想了想，楚阳还是决定试探一下：“额，师傅，弟子功力微末，服用了春秋丹也没啥用处。还是给大师兄服用吧？在诸峰大比之中，也好取得好名次。”
这句话，便是试探孟超然是否真的知道石千山的真面目。
这么一说，谈昙两道眉毛顿时急得上下乱抖，恨不得堵住楚阳的嘴，差点就要破口大骂了：傻.逼呀傻.逼呀，师傅好不容易给你了，你小子闷声发大财就好了，怎地还这么傻的往外出让？
石千山的脸上也是露出一丝期盼。
三人目光同时看向孟超然，谈昙是焦虑，石千山是忐忑中带着期待，还有一丝贪婪；而楚阳的目光却很平静。
“不必。你大师兄又没受伤……他用不到这个。”孟超然淡淡的道，他迎着楚阳的目光，微微一笑：“再说你现在的境界跟你大师兄也相差无几……恩，就这样吧。不必再说了。”
楚阳脸色一苦，孟超然这句话分明是别有含义。自己现在是武徒三级，大师兄石千山则是武士四级，相差不可以道里计，怎地说‘你俩境界相差无几’？
孟超然这句话的真正意思应该是：你俩的阴险狡诈已经差不多了……冤枉啊师傅，我是纯洁滴啊……楚阳心中大叫一声……
孟超然再次深深地看了这位弟子一眼，拂袖站起身来，道：“你们好好修炼，三月后，我亲自带你们登上聚云峰！”
居然就这么出门，随即不见影子了。

三人面面相觑，石千山眼睛看着楚阳手中那一个小玉瓶正发出柔和的光芒，脸上的肌肉忍不住抽搐了两下。
自己费尽心机，不就是为了这东西？却就在自己眼前没了……
“大师兄，多谢。”楚阳貌似很诚挚的向石千山道谢道：“若不是大师兄提出为小弟补身体，师尊怎么会将这万金难求的神丹赐给我……说起来，这都是大师兄的成全啊。”
石千山张了张嘴，脸上比哭还难看的笑道：“师弟哪里话，这是师父特意赐给你，正是师恩深重啊。”
神丹阴差阳错的从自己手中飞了，偏偏得到神丹的人还真心诚意的向自己道谢……自己一肚皮的难受，却不敢发作半点出来。这时候的石千山，在心中已经懊恼到了极点，恨不得狠狠地打自己的嘴巴：让你丫嘴贱！你说那句话干什么？
楚阳笑了一声，倒转瓶口，倒出来一颗色泽红透的弹丸，一出瓶，顿时满室异香。楚阳笑呵呵的道：“听说这东西可是好东西，吃一颗居然就能增加一年功力！虽然增长有些少……却也不能浪费啊，我这就服用，还烦劳师兄师弟帮我护护法……”
石千山脸上顿时痉挛了一下。增长有些少？你居然还嫌少？你信不信天上会打雷的？

content_en:
With his mood shaken, Meng Chaoran couldn't leave now even if he insisted on leaving.
"I can't get out for the time being. I need to retreat for a while." Meng Chaoran's eyes narrowed and he looked at Chu Yang for a while. Seeing that Chu Yang's expression was as usual, as if the words he just said were just unintentional words, he smiled helplessly.
I just said I wanted to go out, but then I couldn't say it anymore. Things like these, which were changed from day to day, would have been the easiest to be despised by others, but Meng Chaoran seemed to have no scruples and just said it calmly. It seems that this kind of thing is very common.
"Well, by the way. Chu Yang should take this Spring and Autumn Pill." Meng Chaoran raised his hand with a smile, threw a small jade bottle over, and said: "Qianshan also said just now that Chu Yang's injury needs to be patched up. Let's patch it up with this." There seemed to be a hint of ridicule in his smile, which was quite meaningful...
Shi Qianshan's expression suddenly changed!
Spring and Autumn Pill is used to improve one's physical strength, how can it be used to replenish blood and body? There are so many healing medicines in the sect, why do you need to use Spring and Autumn Pill?
What he said was just to make the master feel bad about the two junior brothers. How could it be self-defeating and destroy the Spring and Autumn Pill all at once?
This...how did you say this?
Chu Yang sensitively saw the flash of ridicule at the corner of Meng Chaoran's mouth, and couldn't help but smile bitterly: It seems that Shi Qianshan's conspiracy and conspiracy are all in the eyes of his master... But, why did he never stop it?
Also, the reason why he was given the Spring and Autumn Pill this time was definitely because of his saying, "Heaven and earth will not move, and rivers and stones will not turn." But my master was so calm that he didn’t ask anything...
After thinking about it, Chu Yang decided to test it: "Well, master, my disciple's skill is very low, and taking the Spring and Autumn Pill is of no use. Should I give it to the senior brother? In the competition between the peaks, I can get a good ranking."
This sentence is to test whether Meng Chaoran really knows Shi Qianshan's true face.
When he said this, Tan Tan's eyebrows suddenly trembled with anxiety. He wished he could stop Chu Yang's mouth, and he almost cursed: Silly, stupid, stupid, stupid, the master finally gave it to you, you just want to make a fortune in silence, why are you so stupid to give it away?
Shi Qianshan's face also showed a hint of hope.
The three of them looked at Meng Chaoran at the same time. Tan Tan looked anxious, Shi Qianshan looked anxious with expectation and a hint of greed, but Chu Yang's eyes were calm.
"No need. Your senior brother is not injured...he won't need this." Meng Chaoran said lightly. He met Chu Yang's gaze and smiled slightly: "Besides, your current realm is not much different from that of your senior brother...Well, that's it. No need to say more."
Chu Yang's expression turned bitter. Meng Chaoran's words clearly had a different meaning. I am currently a third-level warrior, while my senior brother Shi Qianshan is a fourth-level warrior. The difference is huge. How can I say, 'You two are almost the same in realm'?
The real meaning of Meng Chaoran's words should be: You two are almost as cunning as you are... It's unfair, Master, I am pure... Chu Yang yelled in his heart...
Meng Chaoran once again took a deep look at this disciple, stood up and said, "You should practice well. After three months, I will personally take you to Juyun Peak!"
He actually went out like this and disappeared immediately.
The three of them looked at each other in confusion. Shi Qianshan looked at the small jade bottle in Chu Yang's hand that was emitting a soft light, and the muscles on his face couldn't help but twitch twice.
Isn't it just for this thing that I have worked so hard? But it disappeared right before his eyes...
"Elder brother, thank you very much." Chu Yang seemed to sincerely thank Shi Qianshan and said, "If it hadn't been for the elder brother's offer to replenish my body, how could the master have given me this elixir that is so hard to find... Speaking of which, this is all thanks to the elder brother."
Shi Qianshan opened his mouth and said with a smile that was uglier than crying: "Junior brotherAfter all, this is specially given to you by Master. It is because of Master’s profound kindness. "
The magic elixir flew out of his hand by mistake, but the person who got the magic elixir sincerely thanked him... I felt very uncomfortable, but I didn't dare to let it out. At this time, Shi Qianshan was extremely annoyed in his heart, and he wanted to slap himself in the mouth: I made you such a bitch! Why did you say that?
Chu Yang laughed, turned the bottle over, and poured out a bright red pellet. As soon as it came out of the bottle, the room was filled with a fragrant aroma. Chu Yang said with a smile: "I heard that this stuff is a good thing, and eating one can actually increase your skill for a year! Although the growth is a little small...but it can't be wasted. I will take it now, and I will ask my senior fellow apprentices to help me protect the law..."
Shi Qianshan's face suddenly twitched. Growth is a bit slow? You still think it’s too little? Do you believe there will be thunder in the sky?
